product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace experience platform for organizations to manage employee communications, intranets, digital signage, room booking, and visitor management in one place.

employee_band.notes: Company-size band reported on LinkedIn, not an exact headcount.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog primarily contains workplace advice and product explanations. Reviewed technical articles did not establish two engineer-authored posts about how Appspace is built.

public_docs.notes: A public Knowledge Center provides platform-management, device-configuration, and support documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists seven openings; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, and Gemini Enterprise through bring-your-own-model connections.
model_provider.notes: These are supported customer-connected options; the page does not name the underlying model or provider used by Appspace's default AI.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly listed claims; GDPR denotes compliance rather than a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Accel-KKR investment announced September 21, 2023; the amount was not disclosed. CB Insights classifies the round as Private Equity - II.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was September 21, 2023, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open positions include a UK Business Development Representative and multiple Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 10, 2026 Dorado announcement expanded the Insights Assistant across the platform with AI-powered conversational analytics.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 19, 2026, Appspace announced Eric Daggett as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Development Representative posting explicitly names these platforms as tools the team uses.
